+            for _ in range(WORLD - dy):
+                move(South)

+        parent = []
+        up_hop = []
+        down_hop = []

+            graph.append([])
+            walls.append([])
+            seen.append(False)
+            parent.append(-1)
+            up_hop.append(None)
+            down_hop.append(None)

+        trail = []
+        p = home
+        visited = 0

+                    return None

+                order.append(p)

+        left = []
+        right = []
+        for u in range(len(rows)):

+            y = db[u]
+            if x + 1 < y:

+                if u == a:

+                left.append((u, x + 1, next_hop, rows[u]))
